decision: Retain route validation only. Existing production code passes Jun native transition/ENet/independent solo continuation and the Shaina/Fairuz entry boundary; no new product fix or build is justified by these runs.
scope: Jun starts from an explicitly prepared q.gz19k.q72h=2 / b.bz7g.R72=1 boundary with a distinct protagonist and bag. No dialogue completion, transformation, actor placement or later quest flag is forced.
The unchanged original bz7g MOB supplies all subsequent dialogues, waits, copy operations, redeployment and LeaveToZone. Scripts are not dispatched directly by the fixture.

The network guest begins with an independently saved matching story boundary and distinct stats, name, money and inventory. Normal join/bring admission, native authority changes, save/package RPC and actual received files are used. The origin file remains unchanged.

ENet uses two MultiplayerAPI roots in one Godot process. CampaignState.watch is bound to the authority because it is a process-global hook. This is not a multi-process transport, WAN or physical keyboard/mouse test.

Shaina is the authored party name; the merc8 character in the supplied LiA data is Fairuz. Its prepared boundary contains the FSusel protagonist after q7h, without the companion Kel. The actual brief_23 conversation creates the role, starts q8h and travels to the native entrance; the original hero and bag stay parked.

Windows runtime, internet latency, device input and all earlier renderer/performance limitations remain open. Existing .7 Linux/Windows archives were not changed or rebuilt.
